Left long bed potatoes, centre rear bed soybeans, right long bed lettuce. Never alter bed dimensions, move a corner, add more beds or replace room architecture. REMOVE the old dark wrap outside the left brick walls in EVERY panel. Those brick faces remain exposed.

Top RIGHT: same unplanted room, add ONLY an opaque dark-brown foil-backed FABRIC surface cover across the HORIZONTAL OPEN TOP of the left potato bed. Five small overlapping planting flaps/slits run along its centre, closed but visible. Drip tube is retained along edge with emitters directed under cover. No plants in any bed.
Bottom LEFT: exact top-left room with three independent newly planted crop zones: a sparse row of small potato shoots in LEFT, small soybean seedlings centre REAR, lettuce seedlings RIGHT. Same small seedlings as reference final panel; no dark cover. Everything else fixed.
Bottom RIGHT: exact bottom-left planted room PLUS exactly the same opaque HORIZONTAL potato cover as top-right. Potato shoots emerge freely through loose small overlapping openings; their leaves and stems ABOVE the cover remain lit and unobstructed. Cover blocks the medium between stems while all exterior brick faces remain exposed. Soy and lettuce unchanged. No large collar, trellis, mature plants or opaque cover over foliage.
Strong continuous material perspective, restrained warm cream/terracotta/teal painterly scene. Four panels differ ONLY in plants and actual useful horizontal potato light cover.
